Feeling frustrated? Do you lack confidence when you speak? Do you feel unsure about how to progress in your language studies? Do you feel confused by all the resources and options available? 1. Clearly define your goals and create a programme which helps you learn more effectively, is specific to your needs and gets you the results you want.
2. Assess your current strengths and weaknesses, identify any gaps in your learning strategies and find solutions so you can make progress faster.
3. Try out different techniques and methods and reflect on how effective they are, to find the ones that work best for you, so you can teach yourself.
4. Explore what you think about language learning and work to overcome any mental blocks.

Throughout the course, I am there to support and motivate you. I am also there to make sure you get the results you want! We work together to find solutions and I provide exercises and activities that are specific to your needs and give you immediate feedback, so that through this deliberate practice you can fulfil your goals. We do all of this at your own speed. 

If you want to take your learning to the next level and your language skills even further, this is the course for you!

pro_course_detail.description:
So, you've spent a long time learning the language with all of it's weird grammar rules and phrasal verbs, but you haven't spent a lot of time speaking with actual English speakers?
Perhaps you have a job lined-up with an English speaking company and you want to make sure that you're clearly understood by your boss and peers?
Maybe you plan on studying abroad and you're eager to make sure friends and teachers can get everything you're saying?

If any of this sounds like you then I think I have the perfect lessons for you. Read on for more information.


In my youth and young adulthood I was an actor. I performed in many theatrical plays and did a lot of online filming too. It's through those experiences that I learned and practiced how to be a clear speaker and I'd love to share my tips and tricks on how to speak clear, proper English.

What's more is that I can coach you on different accents from around the English speaking world, from British English (my mother tongue), American, Canadian to Australian just to name the main dialects.

We'll use several of my presentations and other online materials to improve your enunciation, pronunciation, articulation and overall mastery of spoken English.

What's more is that I have been doing this for quite some time now and so people from Brazil, Spain, Italy, Arabic Speaking Nations, Asian Nations and Slavic Nations all have their own unique way of speaking the language. I have identified the key sounds that each of you make and can help you gradually coach you to reduce your accent and generally improve in your target accent.

Thank you for your consideration.

Teacher Mike

pro_course_detail.title: Counseling and Emotional Support
pro_course_detail.description:
I've been teaching on Italki for a while now and a compliment that I often get from a lot of my students is the fact that I am a very good listener. They say that I am very good at listening to their problems and offering helpful and meaningful advice. 

I am not a licensed Therapist but in the past, I have been a youth worker (teen counseller), child safe-guarder (for schools and centres) and an advocate for at-risk individuals such as those with a mental or physical disability and/or autism (within private hospitals)

What's more is that I've met thousands of people, heard their stories and helped improve their lives for the better. 

From depression to anxiety and even suicidal tendencies, I've supported people emotionally in improving their overall outlook on life and given them confidence to deal with the day to day difficulties they face. 

In our sessions we can talk about your worries, concerns and problems in a confidential and non-judgmental environment.

Sometimes people just want to get things off their chest and express how they are feeling. 
It can be difficult at times to do that with friends or family so I'd like to offer my time and my ear to help you deal with what is affecting you most. A problem shared is a problem halved. Talking about things can help you better understand them in your head. 

Maybe you need a different perspective on a matter to help you see where you can divert your feelings and energy. Perhaps you need someone to tell you that everything is going to be alright! 

I'm happy to help and always ready to hear what you have to say :)

This session focuses on preparing you for a job interview and getting your materials ready to help you get your job.

Whether that is an interview for a University position, first job, career change, promotion or any other interview I will give you the tools to ace that interview. 

Behavioural Interview Questions 
Behavioural interview questions delve into how candidates handled past situations to learn about their ability to perform in a position. 
These are the type of questions that start with something like, "Give me an example of..." or "Tell me about a time...." or “Describe an occasion when….” or “Outline a situation….” The popular behavioural question is, “Give me an example of when you had to deal with a difficult customer.”

The STAR Method
The STAR interview method is a technique you can use to prepare for behavioural and situational interview questions. STAR stands for situation, task, action and result. This method will help you prepare clear and concise responses using real-life examples.

Online Interview Preparation 
Review standard video interviewing etiquette
Learn to navigate the various video conferencing platforms
Explore video interview preparation tips
Go over potential video interview questions

pro_course_detail.title: General English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
If you want to have some general conversation practice, this is the class for you. 

This class is open to anyone, regardless of level, and we can talk about pretty much anything. If you have some ideas for the class, let me know beforehand and I can prepare some questions or other material such as an article, a video etc. If you don't know what to talk about, that's fine too; I have plenty of topics we can use.

As the focus of this lesson is on conversation, speaking with fluency is more important than being perfectly grammatically accurate, so unless you specify that you want lots of corrections I will only correct any serious or repeated errors, or anything that doesn't make sense. This way, the conversation will be more natural and more reminiscent of how your conversations with native speakers will go. No native speaker will interrupt you every minute to remind you that you missed an article or forgot to use an irregular past tense form.

This is a zero-pressure class, so just come prepared to talk and don't worry if you make a few slips.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
As someone who studies Spanish, I know how challenging it can be to learn a foreign language. I have taught students of diverse nationalities and different levels, and I therefore understand the varying needs of individual students. 

In my lessons I will adapt to you, focus on your needs, and help you with any difficulties that you might be having. Do not be afraid to ask me about something as many times as you like – I am very patient and always happy to help! I am organised and will work with you to create a plan that enables you to achieve your goals.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are based on the ‘communicative approach’ to language teaching; this means that I will encourage you to speak as much as possible (whilst I listen for any grammar issues and gaps in your vocabulary) and provide you with feedback so that you learn to communicate using the target language.

I can help you to widen your vocabulary (including colloquialisms and idioms) and we can also work on intonation and pronunciation so that your English sounds more natural. We can use a variety of materials during lessons (such as articles, audios, textbooks, videos etc.) and talk about topics that interest you. 

I hope to meet you very soon!

pro_course_detail.title: General English - Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
In these lessons, we will work on the four language skills (speaking, listening, reading and writing). After assessing your level, I will create a personalised study plan for you which will ensure that you achieve your goals. 

During each lesson, there will be many opportunities for you to speak and receive regular feedback (including pronunciation). We will also study grammar and vocabulary which will be useful to you when communicating in English. We can study a range of topics using coursebook materials, PowerPoint presentations, articles, audios and videos (such as TED Talks). I can also give you homework if you would like further practice opportunities after each lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Exam Preparation - IELTS, Cambridge Exams - B2 First and C1 Advanced (5 lessons)
pro_course_detail.description:
When you take your IELTS or Cambridge exam, it is really important to understand the format of the exam and what is expected of you. We will work together as a team to ensure that you feel fully prepared when the day of the exam finally arrives, and so that you can achieve the score that you need.
 
An important part of the lessons will be preparing the Speaking test, and I will also set writing tasks for you to do which I will then correct. Additionally, we can also work on your listening and reading skills if it's necessary. What's more, don't be afraid to ask for help if you wish to deepen your knowledge about something related to grammar, vocabulary, or pronunciation - I have a wide range of fantastic resources to help you.
